title: source map link doesn't work with jsDelivr because of absolute URL
body: ## 🐛 Bug description JSDelivr on this file: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/instantsearch.js@4.5.0/dist/instantsearch.production.min.js has at the end `//# sourceMappingURL=instantsearch.production.min.js.map`. This should mean a relative file, but in some cases this seems to be interpreted as an absolute URL and the source map loaded is `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/instantsearch.production.min.js.map` ## 🔍 Bug reproduction **Steps to reproduce the behavior:** 1. Go to https://xo94wl403z.csb.app 2. open network panel 3. see http 404 **Live reproduction:** https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js (yes, the default link has this issue) ## 💭 Expected behavior source maps are loaded relatively and not absolutely ## Additional context I think jsDelivr somehow might be responsible for this, but not sure yet, would need to experiment if the default maybe is absolute URL and the link it should say is `./instantsearch.production.min.js.map` instead
